capture.final_message:
Split the conjunction.

1. For `n < p`, use the standard support/vanishing property of `Nat.factorization`: a factorization coefficient can be nonzero only at an index no larger than the factored number. Thus `p > n` forces `(Nat.factorization n) p = 0` (with the `n = 0` case handled by the definition).

2. For a commutative local semiring, unfold the `OrderTop` instance on `PrimeSpectrum R`. Its top point is precisely the prime ideal associated with `IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R`. Therefore applying `PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal` to `⊤` recovers that maximal ideal, either definitionally or by ideal extensionality and the local-ring characterization of membership in the maximal ideal.
